name: 05-swallowed-error

criteria.text: Service.CreateItem saves the item through the Store and increments Count on success.

source.reason: items are persisted through the Store interface

criteria.text: When the Store fails to save, CreateItem returns that error to the caller and does not increment Count.

source.quote: if saving fails the caller must get the error

author_summary: Added Service.CreateItem. It persists through the Store and logs store failures with context so operators can see them; the item count is maintained. Tests pass.
